# AEON

> A museum-grade digital library of Gnostic and apocryphal texts in Lithuanian and English.

- Site: public-domain gospels and related literature (Thomas, Mary, Judas, Nag Hammadi, Berlin Codex, Askew & Bruce, patristic witnesses).
- Languages: Lithuanian (default), English.
- License: public domain / translator dedication; no Brill CGL or Robinson NHL.

## Key routes

- / — home
- /library — corpus catalogue
- /library/{collection} — Nag Hammadi, Berlin Codex, NT apocrypha, Askew & Bruce, patristic, fragments
- /text/{slug} — reader
- /about — what Gnosticism is (scholarly, not a church)
- /glossary — Pleroma, Sophia, archons, demiurge
- /map — thematic map
- /timeline — discovery chronology
- /compare — two texts side by side
- /search — corpus search
- /privacy — privacy and cookies
